title: 10AM-1PM South Lake Tahoe 3-Hour Stand Up Paddleboard Rental
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Lake Tahoe's waters are some of the clearest in the world, and viewing them from a paddleboard's standing position lets your see more clearly into their deep blue depths. Our shallow water launch at El Dorado Beach is easy for beginners, and a short 10 minute paddle takes you to sweeping views of the tallest mountains in Lake Tahoe, and a pristine beach along a wildlife preserve.
